title: Source
description: Bibliographic metadata for one source. Metadata, links and a short ORIGINAL summary only: never paste copyrighted text.

id.description: Convention: firstauthor-year[-word], e.g. narasimhan-2019. Must match the file name.

authors.description: 'Family, Given' format. Use 'et al.' as the last item for long author lists.

year.description: Publication year. For ancient texts, the approximate year of composition (negative = BCE).

edition.description: For primary texts: which edition / translation, and translator.

summary.description: A short summary in YOUR OWN words (max 600 characters). No copied text.

status.description: verified = a human opened this source and confirmed the metadata and its relevance.
